files.role: [CHANGED] Markdown ingestion CLI plus the shared upsert core. This sprint: promotes SLUG_LIKE_RE (from essays.py's private copy) to a public module constant; adds extract_nugget_keys(); extends upsert_document with a new first step (nugget-reference resolution against essaycards.nuggets, raising IngestionError naming every missing key) and a per-section section_nuggets resync step; extends _upsert_essay to read/write main_spine_markdown. _parse_front_matter is UNCHANGED (no main_spine_markdown front-matter key this sprint).

public_objects.name: SLUG_LIKE_RE
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] Compiled ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ — promoted from essays.py's private _SLUG_LIKE_RE (R-CON-BP-07, one canonical definition). Used for slug/anchor_slug/card-id validation (essays.py) and nugget_key validation (nuggets.py).

public_objects.name: IngestionError
public_objects.purpose: Unchanged. Now also raised by upsert_document's new nugget-resolution step, not only by markdown parsing functions.

methods.name: ingest
methods.purpose: Unchanged signature/behavior — delegates to _parse_document then upsert_document.

methods.name: upsert_document
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Now: (1) resolves every [[nugget:key]] reference across doc.get('main_spine_markdown','') and every section's body_markdown against essaycards.nuggets BEFORE any write, raising IngestionError naming all missing keys at once; (2) upserts the essay including main_spine_markdown; (3) per section, after _upsert_section, resyncs essaycards.section_nuggets to that section's current references.

methods.name: extract_nugget_keys
methods.purpose: [NEW] Strip fenced code blocks and inline code spans with a regex pass, then match \[\[nugget:([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\]\] on the remainder; return the set of referenced keys. Character class matches SLUG_LIKE_RE exactly (11_design_review.md Minimal Change Set item 1).

private_objects.purpose: Unchanged.

private_objects.purpose: Unchanged — nugget_id is never touched by ingestion (set exclusively by POST /flashcards/upsert).

private_objects.name: _resolve_nugget_references
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Given cur and the union of referenced keys, SELECT id, nugget_key FROM essaycards.nuggets WHERE nugget_key = any(%s); raise IngestionError naming every unresolved key if any; else return dict[key, id]. Called once at the start of upsert_document (internal_flow step 2).

private_objects.name: _resync_section_nuggets
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Given cur, section_id, and that section's resolved nugget ids: INSERT ... SELECT %s, unnest(%s::uuid[]) ON CONFLICT (section_id, nugget_id) DO NOTHING, then DELETE ... WHERE section_id = %s AND NOT (nugget_id = any(%s::uuid[])). Called once per section in the upsert_document loop (internal_flow step 4).
